archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) + Apple HIG Premium Feel
design_philosophy: Crisp, frictionless, and instantly responsive. This POS balances the authoritative, high-contrast clarity needed for rapid transactional environments with the premium, glass-like fluidity of a native Apple experience. Every interaction is highly legible, touch-optimized, and built to trust.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Apple-like margins with safe-area protection.
spacing_and_layout.touch_targets: Min 44px height for all interactive elements.

instructions_to_main_agent.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case, role-based format (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='pos-category-tab').
instructions_to_main_agent.pwa_setup: Ensure manifest.json includes theme_color: '#FBFBFD', display: 'standalone', and apple-touch-icon links in index.html. Add meta tag for apple-mobile-web-app-capable='yes'.
instructions_to_main_agent.safe_areas: Apply pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom)] to bottom bars (cart, checkout actions) and pt-[env(safe-area-inset-top)] to the top navigation header.
instructions_to_main_agent.fonts: Install and configure Outfit and Manrope via Google Fonts in index.html, not local hosting. Ensure fallback is system-ui to guarantee the Apple native feel if web fonts fail.
instructions_to_main_agent.icons: Use lucide-react for all iconography. Keep strokeWidth to 1.5 or 2 for a crisp, Apple SF Symbols look.
instructions_to_main_agent.language: App is in Spanish. Ensure all text strings, empty states, and errors are in Latin American Spanish (e.g., 'Corte de caja', 'Cobrar', 'Efectivo').
